About us:  
  Airtm  is a financial-infrastructure company building the future of the online-work economy. We are on a mission to empower the world's growing number of Digital Entrepreneurs in the Global South, giving them the financial freedom to thrive. 
 The problem is clear: in emerging markets, accessing the dollar economy is difficult. Cross-border payments are slow, expensive, and often lose value to inflation. This limits the potential of millions of talented individuals. 
 Airtm’s solution is a swift and comprehensive financial platform that facilitates low-value cross-border payments and local cash-outs. As pioneers in stablecoin-payment infrastructure, Airtm has built the most advanced cross-border payment system available on the market. 
 As a company married to the world of online work, Airtm will go beyond payments to build the necessary infrastructure the online-work economy needs to thrive. We are fostering an entirely new economy, giving individuals, communities, and countries the tools to take control of their financial destinies.  
 About the Role 
 We're looking for a Head of Security to build and lead security at Airtm, reporting to the VP of Engineering. You'll own the security posture of the systems that move people's money across borders, from application code and cloud infrastructure to identity, vendors, and incident response. You'll set the strategy, build the team and the practices around it, and stay hands-on enough to make the hard technical calls yourself. 
 Our stack is TypeScript/Node.js microservices on Kubernetes (AWS), with React front ends, organized into autonomous product teams. Security here works as an enabler embedded in how teams ship, not a gate at the end. AI-assisted development is core to how we build, so you'll be expected to use AI tooling fluently for security work, and to define how we adopt AI agents and LLM-powered systems safely. 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 
  Security Strategy & Roadmap : Define and own a risk-based security strategy for a financial platform; prioritize investment by real threat and business impact, and report on posture to executive leadership and the board 
 
 
  Incident Response : Own detection, response, and recovery for security incidents; maintain runbooks, lead incidents and post-incident reviews, coordinate with forensics, legal, and communications, and turn every incident into lasting improvements 
 
 
  Application Security : Embed security into the SDLC with threat modeling, secure design reviews, SAST/DAST/dependency scanning, and secure coding standards that engineers actually adopt 
 
 
  Cloud & Infrastructure Security : Partner with Infrastructure to harden AWS, Kubernetes, networking, and CI/CD pipelines; own IAM and least-privilege access, secrets management, and security in Terraform and GitOps workflows 
 
 
  Detection & Monitoring : Build the detection and alerting capability that finds malicious activity early, across application, infrastructure, and access logs, and tune it to keep signal high 
 
 
  Crypto & Key Security : Own the security model for key management, wallet and custody operations, and the blockchain integrations our payment rails depend on 
 
 
  Fraud & Account Security Collaboration : Work with Product and Risk teams on account takeover, abuse, and transaction-level controls 
 
 
  AI Security : Define guardrails for AI coding tools and for AI agents and LLM pipelines we build or deploy, including agent permissions, prompt injection, data exposure, and tool-access boundaries 
 
 
  Compliance & Assurance : Own our security compliance program (SOC 2 and related frameworks), audits, and customer and partner security questionnaires, aiming to make compliance a byproduct of good engineering rather than a separate burden

You'll learn customer environments, uncover blockers, and translate product capabilities into practical solutions. You're also the front line for technical support.  AEs own renewals and expansion. You own making customers successful with the product and building repeatable motions that scale.

 Own post sales relationship as the main point of contact and technical advisor

 Relationship building and executive alignment with our Champions 
 
 
 Conducting Quarterly Business Reviews with strategic customers 
 
 
 Build measurable customer success plans 
 
 
  Onboarding & Implementation  
 
 
 Lead technical onboarding for new enterprise customers, from initial setup through full integration 
 
 
 Work with engineering teams to configure Socket across CI/CD systems, build pipelines, IDEs, and internal tooling 
 
 
 Build repeatable onboarding playbooks, scripts, and automations that reduce time-to-value

 Conduct architecture reviews and security posture assessments 
 
 
 Deliver workshops, office hours, and deep-dives that drive adoption 
 
 
  Customer Advocacy  
 
 
 Bring technical feedback and field intelligence back to Product and Engineering 
 
 
 Surface patterns that inform roadmap priorities 
 
 
 Contribute documentation and internal tooling to scale the Technical Success practice

 3 years in a technical customer-facing role (Solutions Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Support Engineer, or similar)

 Background in Socket's key product areas: Application Security, DevSecOps, package managers, or open-source ecosystems OR Linux systems administration, networking, firewalls, and Docker 
 
 
 Experience with developer tooling and CI/CD platforms (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, CircleCI, etc.) 
 
 
 Ability to read and reason about code (JavaScript, Python, TypeScript) 
 
 
 Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, and SaaS integration patterns 
 
 
 Hands-on experience with package managers

  Socket  helps devs and security teams ship faster by cutting out security busywork. Thousands of orgs use Socket to safely find, audit, and manage open source code. Our customers - from Anthropic to xAI, and Figma to Vercel - love Socket (just  check out their tweets  to see for yourself!) 
 Founded by    Feross Aboukhadijeh   , a long-time open source maintainer with software downloaded over a billion times a month, Socket has raised    $      125M in funding    from top angels, operators, and security leaders. 

  About the Role  
 Join Socket to build and scale our patching infrastructure that delivers secure, vetted packages to developers worldwide. You’ll be at the forefront of supply chain security, creating patches for critical vulnerabilities and building the systems that help the entire open source ecosystem stay secure.  
 This role emphasizes deep software engineering expertise, especially in Rust and Unix environments. You'll tackle challenging CLI work—scoping, troubleshooting, and addressing edge cases across multiple package managers. This role combines engineering work with meaningful community impact that benefits the entire ecosystem. As an early member of the Socket team, you’ll help shape how we scale this technology. 

  What You'll Do  
 
 
 Master Socket workflows, tools, and patching processes 
 
 
 Build and maintain CLI tooling used in customer environments. 
 
 
 Implement package-manager integrations and handle ecosystem-specific edge cases. 
 
 
 Translate dependency and vulnerability workflows into reliable developer-facing interfaces. 
 
 
 Debug implementation issues across Unix-based environments. 
 
 
 Work closely with the patch team to scope work, troubleshoot problems, and ship practical improvements. 
 
 
 Contribute to frontend experiences using JavaScript, React, and TypeScript. 
 
 
 Scale patch production to dozens or hundreds of patches per week 
 
 
 Build and improve automated patching infrastructure and tooling 
 
 
 Build APIs and integrations to deliver certified packages 
 
 
 Create tooling for patch quality assurance and testing 
 
 
 Work with security researchers to understand and patch critical vulnerabilities 
 
 
 Give developers quick, safe remediation options for widely-used packages 
 
 
 Help secure the software supply chain for millions of developers 
 
 
  What You'll Bring  
  Required:  
 
 
 3+ years of software engineering experience with production systems 
 
 
 Strong proficiency in Rust and Unix/Linux environments 
 
 
 Proficiency in Node.js, JavaScript, and TypeScript 
 
 
 Experience with package managers (npm, yarn, pnpm) and the JavaScript ecosystem 
 
 
 Understanding of software security concepts and vulnerability management 
 
 
 Experience building and scaling APIs and data processing pipelines 
 
 
 Familiarity with automated testing, CI/CD, and deployment systems 
 
 
  Preferred:  
 
 
 Experience with security tooling, vulnerability scanning, or patch management 
 
 
 Knowledge of software supply chain security challenges 
 
 
 Experience with other package ecosystems (Python, Go, etc.) 
 
 
 Open source contributions or package maintenance experience 
 
 
 Background in DevSecOps or security engineering 
 
 
 Experience with high-throughput data processing systems 
 
 
  Our Interview Process  
 
 
 Informational with a member from our Talent Team 
 
 
 Hiring Manager Interview 
 
 
 Peer Interview 
 
 
 Take-home problem 
 
 
 Internal review of take-home 
 
 
 Live review of take-home 
 
 
 
 
 Debrief 
 
 
 Final Interview with our founder 
 
 
 References 
 
 
 Decision/Offer 
 
 
 Hiring is a big decision on both sides. Read more about our  Hiring Philosophy  and how we approach the process at Socket. 

  Benefits:  Our benefits are crafted to support you and your family, so you can take care of what matters most and thrive in and outside of work. We offer: 
 
 
 Market competitive salary bands 
 
 
 Meaningful equity program
